# Static import fixtures

Twin_Cubes.glb is project-authored mathematical cube geometry, two static nodes
and two opaque base-color materials. No downloaded models/textures or Legacy
implementation are included. Regenerate with `python tools/make_static_fixtures.py`.
The manifest records byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

Bad_Truncated.glb is the same container with its final bytes removed. Import must
fail without replacing the current document/GPU scene or modifying either source.
These are technical fixtures, not the future diagnostic patient or a PBR reference.

Bad_Accessor.glb has an out-of-range POSITION reference. It exercises a malformed
input that could panic inside gltf-json 1.4.1 without application preflight. The
worker must return an error and successfully process the next valid request.

Color_Checker.glb contains two authored quads, a numerical 2×2 RGBA PNG, selected
UVs and linear vertex colors. One source image is shared by two textures with
different sampler settings; the left material is OPAQUE and the right is MASK.
Its mip-chain RGBA footprint is 20 bytes; decoded base pixels are 16 bytes.
Bad_Image.glb has malformed PNG data. Huge_Image_Header.glb declares 32768×32768
dimensions and must fail admission before allocating that image. Regenerate these
with `python tools/make_color_fixtures.py`. No user model/image is bundled.

Pbr_Factors.glb is generated by `python tools/make_pbr_fixture.py`: six smooth
spheres, top row dielectric/bottom row metal, left-to-right roughness0.15/0.5/0.95.
Two triangle markers exercise missing normals and singular-transform fallback.
It contains no images; the sphere geometry/normals are shared in the source.
Use the PBR mode in Summary. This is a mathematical inspection fixture, not a
calibrated or pixel-matched reference render.

MR_Checker.glb reuses project-authored sphere geometry with one numeric2×2 PNG
shared by a base-color SRGB use and metallic/roughness linear use. UV0 is constant,
UV1 varies across the sphere. B/G vary independently of R/A, including alpha0.
Three materials show unit factors,0.5 factors and MR-only with white base fallback.
Decoded pixels16bytes; prospective sampled mip storage40bytes across two formats.
Bad_MR_Image.glb references malformed PNG only from MR materials. Regenerate with
`python tools/make_mr_fixtures.py` after the sphere generator. No external content.

Normal_Checker.glb extends the authored spheres: normal UV2 mirrors U independently
of MR UV1; the same linear image serves MR and normal uses. Cases: authored tangent,
mirrored/nonuniform instance without tangents, degenerate UV with scale0, and absent
NORMAL with ignored authored tangent/negative normal scale. Alpha alternates0/255.
One decoded image/linear mip chain20bytes. Bad_Normal_Image references a bad PNG
only through normal maps. Regenerate with `python tools/make_normal_fixtures.py`.
